summary: First end-to-end smoke test of LA Tracker MVP. Backend auth, RBAC, dashboard stats, workorders CRUD list, and users endpoints working. Frontend login → dashboard KPIs → workorders list → create work order → logout all pass. RBAC UI correctly hides Users nav for operator, and hides Users/New Entry/Create button for viewer. Reports page loads.
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns admin profile (200)
GET /api/users returns 200 for admin, lists admin user
Frontend login page renders, admin login redirects to /dashboard
Dashboard shows KPI (Total Orders=1) and 3 charts (Orders by Jenis, Media Akses, Invoice Status)
Work Orders page loads with search input and table
Create work order: filled pelanggan/alamat/sa_id/bw, saved, redirected to list, new row 'Test Pelanggan T1' visible
Operator UI: Users nav link hidden, workorders create button hidden (operator has view-only? note below)
Viewer UI: Users nav link hidden, New Entry link hidden, Create button hidden
Reports page loads with filters, KPIs (Records, Total Value, Paid) and table placeholder

failed.issue: For operator role the workorders 'Create' button is hidden in UI, though spec suggests operator can create. Backend allows operator POST /api/workorders (only viewer is blocked). This is a UI inconsistency to confirm with product.
failed.evidence: Playwright: operator logged in, workorders-create-button query returned null. Backend RBAC blocks only viewer for POST /api/workorders.

action_items: Confirm intended operator permissions on Work Orders create button. If operator should be able to create, unhide [data-testid=workorders-create-button] for role=operator. If not, tighten backend to also block operator POST /api/workorders.

notes.login_response_field: Token is returned as 'token' (not 'access_token'); AuthContext appears to consume it correctly since UI auth flows all worked.
not_tested: Edit existing work order (pencil icon) — deferred to full QA
httpOnly cookie flag verification (only Bearer path validated end-to-end)
